rival:beanblader|beyby:01.textAtReview: Slow down, little one. Breathe. / Can't breathe! Too busy zooming!

rival:beanblader|beyby:02.textAtReview: The bean waits. The baby rushes. / Rushing's how I'm gonna win!

rival:beanblader|beyby:03.textAtReview: Too fast for your floaty beans! / The beans were not upset. Nor am I.

rival:beanblader|beyby:04.textAtReview: Bet you can't meditate THAT away! / Already did. I feel lovely.

rival:beanblader|breycist:01.textAtReview: You do not watch. I do not worry. / I watched that one. Kinda.

rival:beanblader|breycist:02.textAtReview: Calm beats cool, my friend. / Cool is a type of calm, actually.

rival:beanblader|breycist:03.textAtReview: Didn't look. Still beat the monk. / Your eyes were closed. So were mine.

rival:beanblader|breycist:04.textAtReview: Nice robe. Mine has a zip. / My robe has inner peace. And pockets.

rival:beanblader|buzzsaw:01.textAtReview: Stillness defeats the backflip. / Stillness can't do a double flip!

rival:beanblader|buzzsaw:02.textAtReview: Feet on the ground... well, nearly. / You're FLOATING! That's cheating-ish!

rival:beanblader|buzzsaw:03.textAtReview: Flip, rip, WIN! Hah! / A fine flip. Breathe after it.

rival:beanblader|buzzsaw:04.textAtReview: Upside down beats cross-legged! / Every way up is fine with me.

rival:beanblader|cheatseeker:01.textAtReview: Peace needs no rule book. / Page 9 says peace needs a referee.

rival:beanblader|cheatseeker:02.textAtReview: The beans abide by every rule. / Beans aren't in the rules. Yet.

rival:beanblader|cheatseeker:03.textAtReview: Levitating? Let me check the rules. / The rules do not mention floating.

rival:beanblader|cheatseeker:04.textAtReview: Point mine. Fully rule compliant. / Your compliance brings me peace.

rival:beanblader|fairydancer:01.textAtReview: Float meets flutter. Float wins. / Next time I'm bringing extra wings.

rival:beanblader|fairydancer:02.textAtReview: Your pixie dust is in my beans. / Bean dust is in my wings too!

rival:beanblader|fairydancer:03.textAtReview: A pirouette for the peaceful one! / I accept it with deep gratitude.

rival:beanblader|fairydancer:04.textAtReview: Fairies spin faster than beans! / Beans do not spin. They wait.

rival:beanblader|joyzerker:01.textAtReview: Calm your inner zerker, friend. / My inner zerker says NO! Haha!

rival:beanblader|joyzerker:02.textAtReview: Find balance. Like me. / I have balance! Half joy, half RAGE!

rival:beanblader|joyzerker:03.textAtReview: Yay! Beans everywhere! RAAAH! / Please do not shout at the beans.

rival:beanblader|joyzerker:04.textAtReview: Inner peace? INNER PIECES! / I remain whole. And peaceful.

rival:beanblader|modsmith:01.textAtReview: No mods. Only mindfulness. / Mindfulness doesn't have a gyro.

rival:beanblader|modsmith:02.textAtReview: Your gadgets cannot measure calm. / Hold on, I'm building one now.

rival:beanblader|modsmith:03.textAtReview: My sensors read your calm: 98%. / The other 2% is beans.

rival:beanblader|modsmith:04.textAtReview: Engineered beats enlightened. / Then why are you sweating, friend?

rival:beanblader|pugilist:01.textAtReview: Peace in the face of punches. / I'll punch the peace right back!

rival:beanblader|pugilist:02.textAtReview: Unclench your gloves, friend. / Never! They're comfy!

rival:beanblader|pugilist:03.textAtReview: Pow! Right in the serenity! / My serenity is unharmed.

rival:beanblader|pugilist:04.textAtReview: Float that, monk man! / I shall. Gently. Upward.

rival:beanblader|stancemancer:01.textAtReview: A good stance. Floating is better. / You can't have stance without ground.

rival:beanblader|stancemancer:02.textAtReview: Water flows. Beans float. / Freight trains do not float.

rival:beanblader|stancemancer:03.textAtReview: Grounded beats floating. / Grounded is merely a mood.

rival:beanblader|stancemancer:04.textAtReview: Precision over prayer beads. / The beads are precise too.

rival:beanblader|torquewarden:01.textAtReview: Even mountains drift, Warden. / Not this mountain. Not ever.

rival:beanblader|torquewarden:02.textAtReview: The calm moved the immovable. / Moved? I simply... relocated.

rival:beanblader|torquewarden:03.textAtReview: Your beans are no match for torque. / The beans hold no grudges.

rival:beanblader|torquewarden:04.textAtReview: The wall stands. The beans scatter. / Scattered beans grow back stronger.

rival:beanblader|underdogger:01.textAtReview: Peace to the underdog. / I'll take peace AND the next point!

rival:beanblader|underdogger:02.textAtReview: Lower the horn. Find your calm. / This horn IS my calm!

rival:beanblader|underdogger:03.textAtReview: Horns up for the underdog! / May your horn be ever full of juice.

rival:beanblader|underdogger:04.textAtReview: Never count me out, bean man! / I never count. I just breathe.

rival:beyby|breycist:01.textAtReview: Looked away? I zoomed past you! / I meant to let you past. Obviously.

rival:beyby|breycist:02.textAtReview: Zippy beats drippy! / Excuse me, this tracksuit is ironed.

rival:beyby|breycist:03.textAtReview: Too cool for small fry. / Small fry, BIG bite! Next round!

rival:beyby|breycist:04.textAtReview: Didn't look. Didn't have to, kid. / Look next time! I'm right here!

rival:beyby|buzzsaw:01.textAtReview: I can flip too! Kind of! / Kid, you're a natural! Do it again!

rival:beyby|buzzsaw:02.textAtReview: Faster than your backflip! / Nothing's faster than my backflip!

rival:beyby|buzzsaw:03.textAtReview: Did you see how high I got?! / I saw your shoes! Way up there!

rival:beyby|buzzsaw:04.textAtReview: Backflip beats baby leap! / Baby leap beats you next time!

rival:beyby|cheatseeker:01.textAtReview: Was that legal? Who cares! Point! / I care. I checked. It was legal.

rival:beyby|cheatseeker:02.textAtReview: Your rule book is bigger than me! / And it says you must stand still!

rival:beyby|cheatseeker:03.textAtReview: Rule 4: no tiny zoomies. / That's not a real rule!

rival:beyby|cheatseeker:04.textAtReview: By the book. Literally. / I'll jump OVER your book!

rival:beyby|fairydancer:01.textAtReview: Faster than a fairy! / Faster isn't fancier, little one.

rival:beyby|fairydancer:02.textAtReview: Bye bye, sparkles! / The sparkles will return. Always.

rival:beyby|fairydancer:03.textAtReview: A twirl too quick for the tot! / Not a tot! A TORNADO!

rival:beyby|fairydancer:04.textAtReview: Pixie dust in your hood! / Hey! Now I'm glittery! ...Cool.

rival:beyby|joyzerker:01.textAtReview: Yay! I'm the zoomiest! / YAY! WAIT. GRRR. Yay?

rival:beyby|joyzerker:02.textAtReview: Small and mighty! / Small and mighty? TINY AND RAGEY!

rival:beyby|joyzerker:03.textAtReview: Aww, tiny bey! BURST TINY BEY! / Can't burst what you can't catch!

rival:beyby|joyzerker:04.textAtReview: So cute! SO DEFEATED! / Not defeated! Just reloading!

rival:beyby|modsmith:01.textAtReview: No mods! Just speed! / Speed is a mod you can't buy.

rival:beyby|modsmith:02.textAtReview: Your gadgets can't track me! / Recalibrating... still can't.

rival:beyby|modsmith:03.textAtReview: Calculated your speed. And beat it. / I'll get faster than your maths!

rival:beyby|modsmith:04.textAtReview: My tracker clocked you. Too slow. / Your tracker needs new batteries!

rival:beyby|pugilist:01.textAtReview: Ducked right under your gloves! / Haha! Kid's got moves!

rival:beyby|pugilist:02.textAtReview: Can't punch what's flying! / Watch me try! Again!

rival:beyby|pugilist:03.textAtReview: Pow! Mini knockout! / Mini? I'm the main event!

rival:beyby|pugilist:04.textAtReview: That's how a big kid does it! / Wait till I grow! Next week!

rival:beyby|stancemancer:01.textAtReview: Stance this! Zoom! / Speed fades. Stance stays.

rival:beyby|stancemancer:02.textAtReview: Too quick to see you crouch! / My crouch saw you. Clearly.

rival:beyby|stancemancer:03.textAtReview: Plant your feet, little one. / My feet are for jumping!

rival:beyby|stancemancer:04.textAtReview: Speed meets precision. Precision wins. / Rematch! At MAXIMUM SPEED!

rival:beyby|torquewarden:01.textAtReview: Made the wall wobble! / That wasn't a wobble. Was it?

rival:beyby|torquewarden:02.textAtReview: Fedora? More like Fe-DONE-a! / ...I will allow that one.

rival:beyby|torquewarden:03.textAtReview: Small spin. Big wall. / I'll climb your wall! Zoom zoom!

rival:beyby|torquewarden:04.textAtReview: The wall does not move for babies. / Not a baby! A BEYBY!

rival:beyby|underdogger:01.textAtReview: Two underdogs! I win this one! / Fair play, little legend!

rival:beyby|underdogger:02.textAtReview: Raise your horn to me! / Cheers to the tiny titan!

rival:beyby|underdogger:03.textAtReview: Never count out the big dog! / I can count to ten! Rematch!

rival:beyby|underdogger:04.textAtReview: Horns up! Small fries down! / Fries? I'm the whole meal!

rival:breycist|buzzsaw:01.textAtReview: No flip needed. Just class. / Class is FINE. Flips are FUN!

rival:breycist|buzzsaw:02.textAtReview: Did you flip? I wasn't looking. / You missed the best flip ever!

rival:breycist|buzzsaw:03.textAtReview: Look at THIS one! Upside down! / Fine. I looked. It was alright.

rival:breycist|buzzsaw:04.textAtReview: Even Mr Cool turned to watch! / I was checking my reflection.

rival:breycist|cheatseeker:01.textAtReview: Rule book? I wrote the style guide. / Style guides aren't in the rules.

rival:breycist|cheatseeker:02.textAtReview: Looking for a foul? Keep looking. / Oh, I'm always looking.

rival:breycist|cheatseeker:03.textAtReview: No-look launch? Rule 7 says look. / Rule 7 never saw me coming.

rival:breycist|cheatseeker:04.textAtReview: Clean point. Unlike your sneer. / That's a smirk, my friend.

rival:breycist|fairydancer:01.textAtReview: Cool beats cute, every time. / Cute IS cool, darling.

rival:breycist|fairydancer:02.textAtReview: Even pixies stop to watch me. / We stopped to laugh, actually!

rival:breycist|fairydancer:03.textAtReview: A twirl you HAD to watch! / Fine. One look. It was lovely.

rival:breycist|fairydancer:04.textAtReview: Even the cool guy looked up! / I'd rather look good. And I do.

rival:breycist|joyzerker:01.textAtReview: Calm down. Watch how it's done. / I WATCHED! NOW I'M HAPPY-ANGRY!

rival:breycist|joyzerker:02.textAtReview: Too chill for your chaos. / Nobody is too chill for the ZERK!

rival:breycist|joyzerker:03.textAtReview: Yay! Wipe off that smirk! RAAH! / Smirk's still here. Waterproof.

rival:breycist|joyzerker:04.textAtReview: Cool guy? COOLED GUY! / Still cool. Slightly sweaty.

rival:breycist|modsmith:01.textAtReview: Raw style beats a rewired bey. / You won't say that at version 48.

rival:breycist|modsmith:02.textAtReview: No upgrades. Just me. / That's what worries me.

rival:breycist|modsmith:03.textAtReview: Your smirk isn't in my data. / You can't measure cool, mate.

rival:breycist|modsmith:04.textAtReview: Engineered a no-look counter. / Clever. I still didn't look.

rival:breycist|pugilist:01.textAtReview: Didn't even need to punch. / Then I'll punch twice as hard!

rival:breycist|pugilist:02.textAtReview: Careful, you'll crease the jacket. / That's the plan, fancy pants!

rival:breycist|pugilist:03.textAtReview: Pow! NOW I've got your attention! / Okay, I turned around. Briefly.

rival:breycist|pugilist:04.textAtReview: Knocked the cool right off you! / Cool grows back. Like my hair.

rival:breycist|stancemancer:01.textAtReview: No stance. Just swagger. / Swagger is a stance. A poor one.

rival:breycist|stancemancer:02.textAtReview: Glasses or not, too slow. / These see everything. Even smirks.

rival:breycist|stancemancer:03.textAtReview: Your back was turned. Mistake. / I'll face you... next time.

rival:breycist|stancemancer:04.textAtReview: Form beats fashion. / Fashion IS form, my friend.

rival:breycist|torquewarden:01.textAtReview: Even walls admire this jacket. / This wall admires nothing.

rival:breycist|torquewarden:02.textAtReview: Nice hat. My hair's nicer. / Your hair moved. I did not.

rival:breycist|torquewarden:03.textAtReview: You looked away. I did not. / I looked back. It was worse.

rival:breycist|torquewarden:04.textAtReview: Unmoved by your style. / Everyone's moved by my style.

rival:breycist|underdogger:01.textAtReview: Underdog? I'm the overdog. / Never count me out, fancy!

rival:breycist|underdogger:02.textAtReview: Raise a toast to the smooth one. / I'll toast your NEXT loss!

rival:breycist|underdogger:03.textAtReview: Horns up! Tracksuit down! / It's still zipped. Perfectly.

rival:breycist|underdogger:04.textAtReview: Look at this one, cool guy! / Nah. ...Okay, that was good.

rival:buzzsaw|cheatseeker:01.textAtReview: Find THAT in your rule book! / Page 40: backflips are... allowed.

rival:buzzsaw|cheatseeker:02.textAtReview: Triple-flip launch! Legal? / Checking... it's not NOT legal.

rival:buzzsaw|cheatseeker:03.textAtReview: Rule 12: one flip per launch. / You just made that rule up!

rival:buzzsaw|cheatseeker:04.textAtReview: Fully legal. Unlike that flip. / That flip was art! Art is legal!

rival:buzzsaw|fairydancer:01.textAtReview: A backflip beats a pirouette! / A pirouette is a flip, sideways.

rival:buzzsaw|fairydancer:02.textAtReview: Pixie dust? I flipped through it! / Now you're sparkly. You're welcome.

rival:buzzsaw|fairydancer:03.textAtReview: Grace defeats chaos! / Chaos is just grace with more noise!

rival:buzzsaw|fairydancer:04.textAtReview: Twirl beats twist! / Next time I'll twirl AND twist!

rival:buzzsaw|joyzerker:01.textAtReview: Wheee! Upside down and happy! / HAPPY! UPSIDE DOWN! RAAAH!

rival:buzzsaw|joyzerker:02.textAtReview: Absurd launch! Absurd point! / Absurd! I LOVE IT! I HATE IT!

rival:buzzsaw|joyzerker:03.textAtReview: Fun flip! NOW FLIP OVER! / Way ahead of you! Wheee!

rival:buzzsaw|joyzerker:04.textAtReview: Joy beats flips! RAGE BEATS ALL! / Hah! Best match of the day!

rival:buzzsaw|modsmith:01.textAtReview: No mods needed. Just flips! / Your flips need a gyroscope.

rival:buzzsaw|modsmith:02.textAtReview: Engineer THAT launch! / Already drawing the blueprints.

rival:buzzsaw|modsmith:03.textAtReview: Calculated your flip. Then beat it. / You can't calculate fun!

rival:buzzsaw|modsmith:04.textAtReview: My bey has a flip detector. / Did it detect THAT one coming?

rival:buzzsaw|pugilist:01.textAtReview: Backflip beats boxing! / Wait till I box a backflip!

rival:buzzsaw|pugilist:02.textAtReview: Ding ding! Upside down! / That's not how boxing works!

rival:buzzsaw|pugilist:03.textAtReview: Pow! Right in the backflip! / Haha! Rematch, champ!

rival:buzzsaw|pugilist:04.textAtReview: Gloves beat gravity! / Gravity's on MY team, though!

rival:buzzsaw|stancemancer:01.textAtReview: Who needs a stance? Wheee! / Everyone. Especially you.

rival:buzzsaw|stancemancer:02.textAtReview: Balance? I'm upside down! / Somehow that is worse.

rival:buzzsaw|stancemancer:03.textAtReview: Feet on the floor. Point in the bag. / Feet on the floor? How boring!

rival:buzzsaw|stancemancer:04.textAtReview: Precision beats absurdity. / Absurdity will rise again!

rival:buzzsaw|torquewarden:01.textAtReview: I flipped OVER the wall! / Hmph. Walls can be climbed. Once.

rival:buzzsaw|torquewarden:02.textAtReview: Spin the hat! Spin the bey! / Nobody touches the hat.

rival:buzzsaw|torquewarden:03.textAtReview: Land on your feet. Then lose. / I landed on my HEAD. Still smiling!

rival:buzzsaw|torquewarden:04.textAtReview: The wall does not flip. / That's why walls are boring!

rival:buzzsaw|underdogger:01.textAtReview: Raise a horn to that flip! / Cheers! Do another one!

rival:buzzsaw|underdogger:02.textAtReview: Absurd beats underdog! / Never count the dog out!

rival:buzzsaw|underdogger:03.textAtReview: Underdog bites the backflipper! / Ouch! Good bite! Good game!

rival:buzzsaw|underdogger:04.textAtReview: Horns up! Backflips down! / I'll backflip back up!

rival:cheatseeker|fairydancer:01.textAtReview: Rule 3: no glitter in the stadium. / That rule is not in any book!

rival:cheatseeker|fairydancer:02.textAtReview: Wings checked. Barely legal. / Barely legal is still legal, love.

rival:cheatseeker|fairydancer:03.textAtReview: Is graceful against the rules? / Checking. ...Sadly, no.

rival:cheatseeker|fairydancer:04.textAtReview: Read THIS: a pirouette! / Duly noted. Page 22. Grudgingly.

rival:cheatseeker|joyzerker:01.textAtReview: Is rage in the rules? Hm. / RAGE IS IN MY HEART! Hehe.

rival:cheatseeker|joyzerker:02.textAtReview: Two moods. One rule book. / Then get TWO RULE BOOKS!

rival:cheatseeker|joyzerker:03.textAtReview: Point! FIND A RULE FOR THAT! / Searching... page 50... nothing.

rival:cheatseeker|joyzerker:04.textAtReview: Happy! ANGRY! LEGAL! / I'm still checking 'angry'.

rival:cheatseeker|modsmith:01.textAtReview: Those mods... are they legal? / Legal-ish. Strongly ish.

rival:cheatseeker|modsmith:02.textAtReview: Rule 9 bans glowing parts. / There's no rule 9. I checked.

rival:cheatseeker|modsmith:03.textAtReview: My bey passed every inspection. / I'll inspect it again. Slowly.

rival:cheatseeker|modsmith:04.textAtReview: Modded within the rules. Barely. / Barely is my favourite word.

rival:cheatseeker|pugilist:01.textAtReview: Punching the stadium? Rule 2. / I punched the AIR! Totally legal!

rival:cheatseeker|pugilist:02.textAtReview: By the book. Ow, gloves! / Haha! Sorry! Great point though!

rival:cheatseeker|pugilist:03.textAtReview: Did the book see THAT punch? / It saw. It wrote it down.

rival:cheatseeker|pugilist:04.textAtReview: Rules can't stop a knockout! / The rules note it. Reluctantly.

rival:cheatseeker|stancemancer:01.textAtReview: Stance checked. Legal. Mine wins. / You checked my stance? Flattered.

rival:cheatseeker|stancemancer:02.textAtReview: Rule 6: glasses must be clean. / Polished this morning. Try again.

rival:cheatseeker|stancemancer:03.textAtReview: No rule against good posture. / I'll write one. Footnote 4.

rival:cheatseeker|stancemancer:04.textAtReview: Precise. Legal. Point. / Annoyingly, all three are true.

rival:cheatseeker|torquewarden:01.textAtReview: Even walls follow the rules. / This wall WROTE the rules.

rival:cheatseeker|torquewarden:02.textAtReview: The hat. Is it regulation? / The hat is beyond regulation.

rival:cheatseeker|torquewarden:03.textAtReview: Find a rule against me. / Searching. Still searching.

rival:cheatseeker|torquewarden:04.textAtReview: The book bends. I do not. / The book has excellent binding!

rival:cheatseeker|underdogger:01.textAtReview: Rule 8: no horns in the stadium. / This horn's a fan, not a player!

rival:cheatseeker|underdogger:02.textAtReview: Underdog? Rules don't care. / And I don't care about rules!

rival:cheatseeker|underdogger:03.textAtReview: Never count me out! Not even you! / Counted. You're out. Kidding.

rival:cheatseeker|underdogger:04.textAtReview: Find a rule against this toast! / Toasting is allowed. Sadly.

rival:fairydancer|joyzerker:01.textAtReview: A pirouette for both your faces! / Happy face loved it! ANGRY FACE NO!

rival:fairydancer|joyzerker:02.textAtReview: Glitter calms the zerker. / IT DOESN'T! ...It's quite nice.

rival:fairydancer|joyzerker:03.textAtReview: Pretty wings! NOW BURST WINGS! / Wings grow back, sweetie.

rival:fairydancer|joyzerker:04.textAtReview: Twirl! TWIRL INTO THE WALL! / Rude! Graceful, but rude!

rival:fairydancer|modsmith:01.textAtReview: Magic beats mechanics. / Magic is just tech I haven't built.

rival:fairydancer|modsmith:02.textAtReview: Can your mods do a twirl? / They can now. Updating.

rival:fairydancer|modsmith:03.textAtReview: Wing drag calculated. Point. / You measured my wings? Romantic.

rival:fairydancer|modsmith:04.textAtReview: Pixie dust? Filtered. Point. / My dust gets past every filter.

rival:fairydancer|pugilist:01.textAtReview: A dance beats a punch. / Dance AND punch! That's boxing!

rival:fairydancer|pugilist:02.textAtReview: Float like a fairy, darling. / Sting like a glove, mate!

rival:fairydancer|pugilist:03.textAtReview: Pow! Right in the pixie dust! / Oops, now your gloves sparkle.

rival:fairydancer|pugilist:04.textAtReview: Knocked the twirl outta you! / The twirl is eternal, sweetie.

rival:fairydancer|stancemancer:01.textAtReview: Flowing like water? I flow better. / Water doesn't wear wings.

rival:fairydancer|stancemancer:02.textAtReview: Grace over grind. / Grace is just posture with glitter.

rival:fairydancer|stancemancer:03.textAtReview: Steady beats sparkly. / Sparkly will strike back, sweetie.

rival:fairydancer|stancemancer:04.textAtReview: Your spin wobbles. Mine never does. / Wobbling is a dance move!

rival:fairydancer|torquewarden:01.textAtReview: Even walls love ballet. / This wall... tolerates it.

rival:fairydancer|torquewarden:02.textAtReview: Twirled right past the Warden! / I let you. For the art.

rival:fairydancer|torquewarden:03.textAtReview: Sparkles bounce off stone. / Sparkles stick to fedoras, though.

rival:fairydancer|torquewarden:04.textAtReview: Your wings will not move me. / Wait till you see them flap.

rival:fairydancer|underdogger:01.textAtReview: A twirl for the underdog! / And a toast for the fairy!

rival:fairydancer|underdogger:02.textAtReview: Glitter in your horn, sorry! / Sparkly juice! Even better!

rival:fairydancer|underdogger:03.textAtReview: Heavy metal beats ballet! / Ballet IS heavy metal, love.

rival:fairydancer|underdogger:04.textAtReview: Never count me out, sparkles! / I never count. I dance.

rival:joyzerker|modsmith:01.textAtReview: Cool mods! NOW BROKEN MODS! / That's a feature, I promise.

rival:joyzerker|modsmith:02.textAtReview: Calculate THIS! RAAAH! Haha! / Calculating... error... too much joy.

rival:joyzerker|modsmith:03.textAtReview: I predicted both of your moods. / YOU DID? THAT'S CREEPY! Hehe!

rival:joyzerker|modsmith:04.textAtReview: Rage data collected. Thank you. / YOU'RE WELCOME! GRRR! Thanks!

rival:joyzerker|pugilist:01.textAtReview: Haha! Hug? NO! KNOCKOUT! / Haha! Same energy, buddy!

rival:joyzerker|pugilist:02.textAtReview: Happy punches! ANGRY PUNCHES! / I only have happy ones! Pow!

rival:joyzerker|pugilist:03.textAtReview: Pow! Joyful knockout! / Joyful? YES! FURIOUS? ALSO YES!

rival:joyzerker|pugilist:04.textAtReview: Two brawlers, one winner. Me! / One rematch! RIGHT NOW!

rival:joyzerker|stancemancer:01.textAtReview: Stance THIS! RAAAH! / Rage makes your feet wobble.

rival:joyzerker|stancemancer:02.textAtReview: Calm is boring! YAY CHAOS! / Chaos is just stance, unpractised.

rival:joyzerker|stancemancer:03.textAtReview: Calm water beats wild fire. / FIRE IS HAPPY! FIRE IS ANGRY!

rival:joyzerker|stancemancer:04.textAtReview: Breathe. You'll zerk less. / I'LL ZERK MORE! Hehe.

rival:joyzerker|torquewarden:01.textAtReview: Moved the wall! YAY! RAAAH! / The wall shifted. Slightly.

rival:joyzerker|torquewarden:02.textAtReview: Smile, Warden! NO? ATTACK! / I am smiling. Inside.

rival:joyzerker|torquewarden:03.textAtReview: Rage breaks on stone. / Joy goes AROUND stone! Hehe!

rival:joyzerker|torquewarden:04.textAtReview: Neither joy nor rage moves me. / BOTH WILL! NEXT ROUND!

rival:joyzerker|underdogger:01.textAtReview: Cheers! YAY! CHEERS OF RAGE! / That's the spirit! Horns up!

rival:joyzerker|underdogger:02.textAtReview: Joy and zerk beat the underdog! / Never count me out, double guy!

rival:joyzerker|underdogger:03.textAtReview: Underdog wins! Horns up! / YAY FOR YOU! GRRR FOR ME!

rival:joyzerker|underdogger:04.textAtReview: Rock on! Metal beats moods! / METAL IS A MOOD! MY MOOD!

rival:modsmith|pugilist:01.textAtReview: Glove-proof shielding. Works. / Then I'll punch harder!

rival:modsmith|pugilist:02.textAtReview: Predicted your punch. Dodged. / Predict this one, egghead!

rival:modsmith|pugilist:04.textAtReview: No mods. Just muscles! / Muscles don't get firmware updates.

rival:modsmith|stancemancer:01.textAtReview: Engineering beats posture. / Posture is engineering, for people.

rival:modsmith|stancemancer:02.textAtReview: Your stance: 97% perfect. / I'll fix the other 3% tonight.

rival:modsmith|stancemancer:03.textAtReview: Precision beats gadgets. / My gadgets ARE precision.

rival:modsmith|stancemancer:04.textAtReview: Your screws rattled. I didn't. / That rattle is intentional.

rival:modsmith|torquewarden:01.textAtReview: Torque calculated. Exceeded. / Your calculator lies.

rival:modsmith|torquewarden:02.textAtReview: Found the weak point in the wall. / There are none. Check again.

rival:modsmith|torquewarden:03.textAtReview: Your mods mean nothing here. / Taking notes for version 49.

rival:modsmith|torquewarden:04.textAtReview: Gadgets break. Walls do not. / Then I'll build a wall-breaker.

rival:modsmith|underdogger:01.textAtReview: Odds calculated. Underdog lost. / Your maths forgot heart!

rival:modsmith|underdogger:02.textAtReview: Upgraded your horn. It's a launcher. / Brilliant! Can it still hold juice?

rival:modsmith|underdogger:03.textAtReview: Never count me out. Even you! / My count says... a rematch.

rival:modsmith|underdogger:04.textAtReview: Heavy metal beats metal parts! / My parts are also metal!

rival:pugilist|stancemancer:01.textAtReview: Stance this! Pow! / Hm. That was a fine punch.

rival:pugilist|stancemancer:02.textAtReview: Glasses off, gloves on! / The glasses stay. Always.

rival:pugilist|stancemancer:03.textAtReview: Water beats fists. / Wet fists still punch!

rival:pugilist|stancemancer:04.textAtReview: Your swing was wide. Mine was not. / Wide is where the fun is!

rival:pugilist|torquewarden:01.textAtReview: Pow! Even walls feel that! / ...A little. Do not tell anyone.

rival:pugilist|torquewarden:02.textAtReview: Knocked the hat sideways! / The hat is fine. Barely.

rival:pugilist|torquewarden:03.textAtReview: You punched a wall. Wall wins. / Ow! Worth it, though!

rival:pugilist|torquewarden:04.textAtReview: Gloves cannot dent torque. / Then I'll get bigger gloves!

rival:pugilist|underdogger:01.textAtReview: Haha! Brawler beats the dog! / Never count me out, champ!

rival:pugilist|underdogger:02.textAtReview: Pow! Toast THAT! / Cheers! Ow! Cheers!

rival:pugilist|underdogger:03.textAtReview: Horns beat gloves! / Gloves beat horns NEXT round!

rival:pugilist|underdogger:04.textAtReview: Underdog uppercut! Haha! / Haha! Great punch, mate!

rival:stancemancer|torquewarden:01.textAtReview: Water flows round walls. / Walls do not mind. Much.

rival:stancemancer|torquewarden:02.textAtReview: A precise stance moved you. / I moved. Do not get used to it.

rival:stancemancer|torquewarden:03.textAtReview: Stance is good. Torque is better. / Freight trains carry torque too.

rival:stancemancer|torquewarden:04.textAtReview: Your form is steady. Mine is stone. / Water wears down stone. Slowly.

rival:stancemancer|underdogger:01.textAtReview: Precision beats passion. / Passion comes back louder!

rival:stancemancer|underdogger:02.textAtReview: Balanced. Unlike that horn. / This horn has perfect balance!

rival:stancemancer|underdogger:03.textAtReview: Never count me out, glasses! / I never miscount. Rematch.

rival:stancemancer|underdogger:04.textAtReview: Heavy metal hits like a train! / That's my line. Well played.

rival:torquewarden|underdogger:01.textAtReview: The underdog stays under. / Never count me out, big hat!

rival:torquewarden|underdogger:02.textAtReview: Immovable. Even by toasts. / Then I'll toast twice as loud!

rival:torquewarden|underdogger:03.textAtReview: Moved the immovable! Horns up! / Hmph. One step. That's all.

rival:torquewarden|underdogger:04.textAtReview: A toast to the wall-breaker: me! / The wall will remember this.

solo:beanblader:01.textAtReview: Be still. The bean has spoken.

solo:beanblader:03.textAtReview: I did not launch. I simply let go.

solo:beanblader:04.textAtReview: The stadium is calm. Like me.

solo:beanblader:05.textAtReview: Spin is a breath. I breathe deeply.

solo:beanblader:09.textAtReview: Effort is noise. Victory is silence.

solo:beanblader:10.textAtReview: One breath. One rip. One point.

solo:beanblader:11.textAtReview: I float. My opponent does not.

solo:beyby:04.textAtReview: Bet you didn't see me coming!

solo:beyby:12.textAtReview: Catch me if you can! You can't!

solo:breycist:01.textAtReview: Didn't even look. Didn't need to.

solo:breycist:03.textAtReview: Was that a point? I wasn't watching.

solo:breycist:07.textAtReview: Wake me up when it gets close.

solo:breycist:08.textAtReview: Not even a crease in the jacket.

solo:breycist:09.textAtReview: Don't clap. Okay, you can clap.

solo:breycist:10.textAtReview: Same time next round? Same result.

solo:buzzsaw:01.textAtReview: BACKFLIP LAUNCH! Did you see that?!

solo:buzzsaw:03.note: I want this to be "If its stupid and it works, it's not stupid."
solo:buzzsaw:03.textAtReview: If it's stupid and it works, it's not stupid.

solo:buzzsaw:05.textAtReview: That launch had a triple twist!

solo:buzzsaw:07.textAtReview: Did I land it? Who cares! POINT!

solo:cheatseeker:03.textAtReview: The rule book approves of me.

solo:cheatseeker:05.textAtReview: Rule one: I find the gaps.

solo:cheatseeker:06.textAtReview: Hmm. No rules broken. By me.

solo:cheatseeker:09.textAtReview: I read the rules. You should too.

solo:cheatseeker:10.textAtReview: Appendix B: I win this one.

solo:fairydancer:01.textAtReview: A pirouette, a pixie, a point!

solo:fairydancer:02.textAtReview: Float like a fairy, burst like one!

solo:joyzerker:01.textAtReview: Yay! A point! RAAAGH! A POINT!

solo:joyzerker:03.textAtReview: Oops! Did I do that? YES I DID!

solo:joyzerker:04.textAtReview: Best day ever! WORST DAY FOR YOU!

solo:joyzerker:05.textAtReview: Hugs for all! BURSTS FOR ALL!

solo:joyzerker:06.textAtReview: Joy level: max! Zerk level: MAX!

solo:joyzerker:11.textAtReview: Aww, a point! GRRR, A POINT!

solo:modsmith:05.textAtReview: A few screws loose? On purpose.

solo:modsmith:06.textAtReview: My bey has more mods than parts.

solo:modsmith:08.textAtReview: Data says I win. Data's right.

solo:pugilist:03.textAtReview: Gloves on, bey out, point in!

solo:pugilist:05.note: Float like a buterfly, sting like a bey!
solo:pugilist:05.textAtReview: Float like a butterfly, sting like a bey!

solo:pugilist:08.textAtReview: Who's next? I'm just warming up!

solo:pugilist:09.textAtReview: Did you feel that? I felt that!

solo:stancemancer:05.textAtReview: Don't let the glasses fool you.

solo:stancemancer:09.textAtReview: The water was calm. Then it hit.

solo:torquewarden:02.textAtReview: You hit a wall. The wall was me.

solo:torquewarden:04.textAtReview: I've seen tougher spins in a teacup.

solo:torquewarden:05.textAtReview: Was that your best? Hm. Okay.

solo:torquewarden:07.textAtReview: Bounce off me all you like.

solo:torquewarden:08.textAtReview: Your spin ends where I begin.

solo:torquewarden:11.textAtReview: Don't take it personally. Do learn.

solo:torquewarden:12.textAtReview: That's all the effort you get.

solo:underdogger:02.textAtReview: Nobody bet on me. Big mistake!

solo:underdogger:04.textAtReview: Raise the horn! Raise the score!

solo:underdogger:05.textAtReview: Told you. Never count me out!

solo:underdogger:07.textAtReview: From the bottom to the top!

solo:underdogger:08.textAtReview: A toast! To me! And that point!

solo:underdogger:09.textAtReview: Rock on, rip on, roll on!

solo:underdogger:10.textAtReview: Odds? I eat odds for breakfast.
